info.title: Staffing Hub API
info.description: Manage employees, their roles, technologies and skills, customers, and missions.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: The staffing situation at a glance.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Specific skills within a technology (e.g. Streams for Java).

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Employees, their manager, roles, technologies and skill levels.

tags.name: Technologies
tags.description: Technologies (e.g. Java, React) and the skills grouped under each one.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Clients that employees can be staffed on.

tags.name: Absences
tags.description: Time employees are away: holidays, sick leave, training. Absences reduce availability.

tags.name: Missions
tags.description: Missions for customers, the skills they require, and the employees assigned to them.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Job roles an employee can hold (e.g. Tech Lead, Developer).

get.summary: Rank the employees who could fill a need, best first
get.description: Score out of 100: how well the employee fits (the mission's required skills 55%, seniority 25%, role 20%), multiplied by the share of the wanted time they are free over the need's period. A criterion the need does not specify counts as met.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many candidates to return (1 to 50)

get.summary: The current user's role and what they may do
List an employee's mission assignments, most recent first
Find who is available over a period, most available first (paginated)
get.description: Accepts the same filters as the employee search. Availability is what the employee can take on for the whole period: 100% minus their peak occupation on any single day, reduced by the share of working days they are away. Assignments without a start date are ignored, without an end date are ongoing, and without a rate count as 100%. An employee who leaves during the period has 0% availability. Can also be filtered by customer, mission and situation (on the bench, overbooked, away) during the period, and ordered.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the first and/or last name, case-insensitive (e.g. "ada", "ada love")

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: Only employees with this role

parameters.name: technologyId
parameters.description: Only employees with this technology

parameters.name: skillId
parameters.description: Only employees with this skill

parameters.name: minSkillLevel
parameters.description: With skillId: only employees at this level or above

parameters.name: managerId
parameters.description: Only the staff of this manager (direct reports, unless includeIndirectReports)

parameters.name: includeIndirectReports
parameters.description: With managerId: also their staff's staff, and so on down the hierarchy (default false)

parameters.name: includeFormer
parameters.description: Include employees whose departure date has passed (default false)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period (included)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the period (included); leave empty for an open-ended period

parameters.name: minAvailability
parameters.description: Only employees with at least this availability (percent) over the whole period

parameters.name: customerId

parameters.name: missionId
parameters.description: Only employees working on this mission during the period

parameters.name: situation
parameters.description: Only employees in this situation during the period

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order of the results (default MOST_AVAILABLE)

parameters.name: page
